auto_renewal_status.description: Auto renewal status, such as will_renew or will_not_renew

current_period_ends_at.description: When the current billing period is expected to end, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

current_period_starts_at.description: When the current billing period started, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

ends_at.description: When the latest billing period is expected to end, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

entitlements.description: List of the entitlements the subscription grants

gives_access.description: Whether the customer currently has access to the subscription's entitlements

id.description: ID of the subscription, generated by RevenueCat

original_customer_id.description: ID of the original customer, for a transferred subscription

ownership.description: Ownership of the subscription, such as purchased or family_shared

pending_changes.description: Changes expected at the end of the current period

presented_offering_id.description: ID of the offering the customer saw when subscribing

product_change.description: Outcome of a product change request

product_id.description: ID of the product; null for promotional subscriptions

redemption.description: Most recent redemption of the purchase's redemption link

starts_at.description: When the subscription started, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

status.description: Status, such as trialing, active, expired, in_grace_period or paused

store.description: Store of the subscription, such as app_store, play_store or stripe

total_revenue_in_usd.description: Total revenue of the subscription in USD: currency, gross, commission, tax, proceeds
